description: Supplementary Table 4 workbook containing DE results, normalized expression matrices, DEG group tables, and annotations.
methods_and_interpretation: Historical manuscript analysis: rlog or DESeq2 size-factor normalization followed by ComBat; pairwise DGEA used rlog+ComBat values with two-tailed tests, BH FDR, and |log2FC| > 1. See manuscript Methods and the individual sheet records below.

description: All 26,169 tested genes with UniProt identifiers and log2 fold changes and FDRs for nine resistant-versus-susceptible genotype-by-time contrasts.
methods_and_interpretation: DEG analysis contrasts Rpv12, Rpv12+1, and Rpv12+1+3 against susceptible at 0, 6, and 24 hpi. Positive log2FCH means higher expression in the resistant genotype.

description: Size-factor-normalized, log2-transformed, ComBat-corrected expression values for 36 samples.
methods_and_interpretation: Size factors were estimated from raw counts; ComBat was applied without condition protection (unprotected). First column is the gene ID.

description: Regularized-log transformed, ComBat-corrected expression values for 36 samples.
methods_and_interpretation: DESeq2 rlog transformation followed by ComBat without condition protection (unprotected). First column is the gene ID.

description: Genes specific to the Rpv12 genotype (Group Va), with temporal pattern codes, identifiers, homology, and annotations.
methods_and_interpretation: Group assignment is based on DEG sharing across the three resistant genotypes; temporal codes summarize regulation at 0, 6, and 24 hpi.

description: Genes specific to the Rpv12+1 genotype (Group Vb), with temporal pattern codes, identifiers, homology, and annotations.
methods_and_interpretation: Group assignment is based on DEG sharing across genotypes; temporal codes summarize regulation at 0, 6, and 24 hpi.

description: Genes specific to the Rpv12+1+3 genotype (Group Vc), with temporal pattern codes, identifiers, homology, and annotations.
methods_and_interpretation: Group assignment is based on DEG sharing across genotypes; temporal codes summarize regulation at 0, 6, and 24 hpi.

description: Genes shared by all three resistant genotypes.
methods_and_interpretation: Rows include genotype-specific temporal pattern codes and sequence/function annotations.

description: Genes shared by Rpv12 and Rpv12+1.
methods_and_interpretation: Rows include genotype-specific temporal pattern codes and sequence/function annotations.

description: Genes shared by Rpv12+1 and Rpv12+1+3.
methods_and_interpretation: Rows include genotype-specific temporal pattern codes and sequence/function annotations.

description: Genes shared by Rpv12 and Rpv12+1+3.
methods_and_interpretation: Rows include genotype-specific temporal pattern codes and sequence/function annotations.

description: Genes with complex temporal or cross-genotype patterns that do not fit Groups I–V.
methods_and_interpretation: CP denotes complex pattern; pattern codes describe up, down, or unchanged status at each sampled time point.

description: Genes upregulated in all three resistant genotypes according to the table's historical DEG calls.
methods_and_interpretation: Upregulation is based on log2 fold-change direction and the historical FDR/effect thresholds.

description: Genes downregulated in all three resistant genotypes according to the table's historical DEG calls.
methods_and_interpretation: Downregulation is based on log2 fold-change direction and the historical FDR/effect thresholds.

description: AlphaFold2-Multimer/ColabFold protein-interaction and domain-analysis workbook.
methods_and_interpretation: A total of 1,645 protein pairs were screened. High-confidence/interface-compatible interpretation uses ipTM >= 0.70, mean pLDDT >= 50, at least five interface contacts, and contact-filtered interface PAE/iPAE < 10 Å where indicated by the manuscript.

description: Predicted protein pairs and structural-quality metrics, including identifiers, transcriptional patterns, homology, interface interpretation, ipTM, pTM, mean pLDDT, interface iPAE/PAE, contact fraction, and interface-contact count.
methods_and_interpretation: ColabFold AlphaFold2-Multimer v3 screen; structural metrics were used to classify interface compatibility. The workbook includes positive/negative or screening interpretation fields.

description: HMMER/Pfam domain annotations for proteins represented in the predicted interaction set.
methods_and_interpretation: HMMER v3.3.2 hmmscan against Pfam-A; rows contain protein identifiers, domain names/accessions, E-values, sequence coordinates, and domain-number estimates.

description: Summary of domain categories, domain-type counts, proportions, and proteins carrying the domains.
methods_and_interpretation: Aggregated from the Pfam/HMMER domain architecture results; categories include LRR, kinase, and EDS1-family domains.

description: All tested protein-pair partners organized by query hub/protein, including Arabidopsis homolog labels.
methods_and_interpretation: This sheet documents the screened candidate space and complements the 61-row interaction-results sheet.

description: Gene annotation and identifier crosswalk for all 26,169 retained PN40024 v4 genes.
methods_and_interpretation: Despite the .csv extension, this file is tab-delimited. Columns include PN40024/Ensembl gene ID, UniProt, NCBI assembly ID, chromosome coordinates, transcriptional pattern, Arabidopsis/TAIR10 homolog identifiers, homology score, common name, and locus tag. Homology was assigned using BLASTP against Arabidopsis proteins (manuscript threshold e-value < 1e-6).

description: Requested protected rlog expression matrix: 26,169 genes plus 36 sample columns.
methods_and_interpretation: Sheet uses DESeq2 rlog values followed by ComBat with genotype-by-time condition included in the ComBat model (condition protected). The matrix is intended for correlation/network analysis and visualization.

description: Condition-protected rlog matrix; first column geneID and remaining columns are the 36 biological samples.
methods_and_interpretation: Sample names encode genotype, time (0/6/24 hpi), and replicate (A/B/C), e.g. Rpv12.6.A.

description: Requested protected size-factor expression matrix: 26,169 genes plus 36 sample columns.
methods_and_interpretation: Raw counts were DESeq2 size-factor normalized, transformed as log2(normalized count + 1), and ComBat-corrected with genotype-by-time condition included in the ComBat model (condition protected). This preserves amplitude more directly than rlog for divergence/amplitude analyses.

description: Condition-protected size-factor/log2 matrix; first column geneID and remaining columns are the 36 biological samples.
methods_and_interpretation: Sample names encode genotype, time (0/6/24 hpi), and replicate (A/B/C), e.g. Rpv12.6.A.

description: Machine-readable summary of the two generated matrix workbooks, sheets, dimensions, and first/last gene IDs.
methods_and_interpretation: Generated during matrix export.
Records R/package versions and the maximum difference from the historical unprotected size-factor matrix.
